timing: Upstream timestamps = frame index / playback FPS; these are not original per-frame container PTS.

coordinate_system.joint_positions: GVHMR world-grounded Y-up coordinates as emitted by upstream extract_motion.
coordinate_system.horizontal_axes: X/Z are estimator world axes; do not assume camera right/forward or R14 alignment.
coordinate_system.root_motion: Unmodified GVHMR smpl_params_world transl/global_orient; no coordinate conversion applied.
coordinate_system.registration: No alignment, rescaling, retargeting or comparison with R14 has been performed.

limitations: Monocular model estimates, not measured ground truth or validated motion capture.
Occlusion, inversion and rapid rotation may produce incorrect depth, left/right identity and contact timing.
Overlay estimates on the source video and review before using them to modify an animation.
Wrist/hand joints do not establish palm orientation or true support contacts.
Upstream model/software licence restrictions remain applicable; reference use does not waive them.
